capabilities: link modified files to a daily, weekly, or monthly note
filter which modified files are logged by criteria
write logs as plain text instead of dynamic queries
track modifications without relying on file modification times
extras: Usage and configuration details are kept in a separate wiki rather than the README; the author advises backing up notes before use.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a persistent record of which files were changed during a given time period.
summary: Plugin that logs links to files modified since the last run into a daily, weekly, or monthly note as plain text.
